study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain charts for the human lifespan

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Totals for the GMV normative control sample (female 38,839; male 38,318; sum 77,157) computed by summing the Sample size column across studies in Supplementary Table 1.2. No separate train/validation split was reported for the cross-sectional reference dataset.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Weighted mean age calculated from the 'Mean Age (in days)' column multiplied by Sample size (Supplementary Table 1.2) and converted to years; minimum and maximum ages taken from the 'Minimum age (in days)' and 'Maximum age (in days)' columns. No train/test split reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "\"Study\",\"Sex\",\"Sample size\",\"Mean Age (in days)\",\"Minimum age (in days)\",\"Maximum age (in days)\"\n\"3R-BRAIN\",\"Female\",146,9796.5,7081.8,13444.4\n\"3R-BRAIN\",\"Male\",184,9932.6,7206,13773.1"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female and male counts summed across all studies in Supplementary Table 1.2; percentages calculated relative to total N=77,157. No explicit training split reported.
